p: by thy name: He declares that when all means fail, God will deliver even by miracle, they who call to him with an upright conscience.
strangers are risen up against me: That is, the Ziphims.
oppressors seek after my soul: Saul and his army who were like cruel beasts, could not be satisfied except by his death.
them that uphold my soul: No matter how few, as he was with Jonathan.
truth: According to your faithful promise for my defence.
freely sacrifice unto thee: For hypocrites serve God out of fear or on conditions.
seen his desire upon mine enemies: We may lawfully rejoice for God's judgments against the wicked, if our affections are pure.
